The background consists of dark, blurry foliage.

The front legs appear disproportionately short and thick compared to the body, suggesting a depth/perspective error common in AI generation where limb length is compressed.
Unnatural edge bleeding between the horse/rider and the dark background, indicative of generative blur rather than optical depth of field.
